name: Kota Kinabalu
tagline: Borneo gateway to Mount Kinabalu, islands and wildlife
summary: Kota Kinabalu is the friendly capital of Sabah in Malaysian Borneo, with islands offshore and Southeast Asia's highest peak inland. Snorkel the Tunku Abdul Rahman islands, hike or view Mount Kinabalu, meet proboscis monkeys on the Klias river and feast at the waterfront night market.
seasonNote: February to September is drier; October to January brings heavy rain.
arrival: Kota Kinabalu International is 15 minutes from the centre.
gettingAround: Grab in town; boats from Jesselton Point to the islands.
cashTip: Cards and Grab work widely; carry ringgit for night markets and hawker stalls.
foodTip: Night-market seafood, tuaran mee and beef noodle soup.
buyTip: Pearls, Borneo crafts and Sabah tea.
